nameOfQualification: Post Graduate Certificate Programme in IT Infrastructure, Systems and Security
description: The objective of this course is to enable the students to understand the concepts of network security and learn the techniques of detecting attacks and securing a network from internal and external attacks. At the end of the course, the student will be able to recognize a variety of generic security threats and vulnerabilities, understand the principles and practices of cryptographic techniques, identify and analyze particular security problems for a given application and apply appropriate security techniques to solve the security issues.
